reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Enable crossplane to be deployed via ko by @n3wscott in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6510", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Deployability via ko is an additional deployment option for Crossplane; the evidence states no failure, rejection, ignored setting, lost permission or required migration, so an operator who does nothing experiences no operational change.

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 adds the ability to deploy Crossplane via ko.
